Buenav Vista Branch Library on Saturday,
October 3rd from 10:00 a.m. to 400 p.m.

and Burbank voters will consider three
local ballot measures that could affect
city services and the future of city
council elections. Burbank voters will
consider measure C, the city services
measure, which would increase the city's
hotel tax from 10% to 12%. The hotel tax
is paid by visitors staying in Burbank
hotels and motel. If approved, Measure C
would generate approximately $3 million
annually in locally controlled funding

emergency response, park and recreation
programs, and other city services. To
learn more about Measure C, visit
burbankca.gov/measure-

elections. Measure CC would amend the
city charter to provide greater

Burbank should transition from at large
to by district city council elections.
